design.title: Ananya Seva Trust — Trust Management Platform
design.reference: Bloomberg Philanthropies annual report + Apple Keynote 2023 cover style — editorial, generous whitespace, single bold accent

slides.title: Cover — Trust Management Platform
slides.task_brief:
COVER PAGE. Use the dark emerald gradient slide variant (.slide.slide-dark with .dot-pattern overlay). Content (render verbatim):

- Tiny eyebrow line (top-left, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.2em, accent gold color): 'ANANYA SEVA TRUST · BOARD BRIEFING'
- Main display headline (Playfair Display, ~76px, italic mix allowed, weight 700, color #fefcf7): 'Trust Management Platform'
- Sub-headline (Playfair Display italic ~32px, color #fef3c7 with 80% opacity): 'Serving Humanity, Building Hope'
- Lead paragraph (Inter, 17px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.78), max-width ~620px, ~50 words): 'A unified digital platform connecting donors, volunteers, and beneficiaries — purpose-built for fundraising growth, transparent governance, and lasting community impact across 220+ villages in three Indian states.'
- Bottom-left meta block: 'PRESENTED TO' (small uppercase gold label) above 'Board of Trustees' (Inter 18px, weight 600, white)
- Bottom-right meta block: 'SEPTEMBER 2026' (small uppercase gold label) above 'Mumbai, India' (Inter 18px, weight 600, white)
- Decorative accent: a small gold accent-bar (44px × 3px) above the main headline
- Bottom center or top-right: a small gold heart mark or circular monogram with letters 'AST' (Playfair italic) — kept subtle

No images, no photos. The slide must feel like a premium annual-report cover.

slides.title: Why This Platform Now — The Imperative
slides.task_brief:
KEY MESSAGE / IMPERATIVE PAGE. Light cream background (.slide).

Header area (top, 64px padding):
- Eyebrow (uppercase, gold, letter-spacing 0.18em, 12px): '01 · THE IMPERATIVE'
- Headline (Playfair Display, weight 700, ~46px, color var(--ink)): 'Why this platform is must-have, not nice-to-have'
- Sub-headline (Playfair italic, ~22px, color var(--ink-soft), max-width 820px): 'Two forces make a unified digital platform urgent for the Trust today — fundraising growth and client connectivity.'

Body — two-column comparison block (use .surface cards side by side, gap 32px):

LEFT CARD — title 'FUNDRAISING GROWTH' (gold uppercase 12px label) with Playfair headline 'Donors expect a digital, receiptable, transparent experience' (~24px). Body paragraph (Inter 16px, ink-soft, ~55 words): 'Cash-and-cheque donations are declining across India while UPI and online giving grow 28% year-on-year. Donors now expect instant 80G receipts, campaign progress visibility, and the ability to give in under 60 seconds — or they give elsewhere.' Three small bullet stats below (gold dot + Inter 13px ink-soft):
• 28% YoY growth in Indian online donations
• 60 seconds — donor patience window
• 80G receipt expected within minutes

RIGHT CARD — title 'CLIENT CONNECTIVITY' (gold uppercase 12px) with Playfair headline 'Beneficiaries, volunteers, partners expect a single front door' (~24px). Body paragraph (Inter 16px, ink-soft, ~55 words): 'Today a beneficiary, a CSR partner, and a volunteer each face different, fragmented touchpoints. A single platform gives every stakeholder one consistent, traceable front door — closing the trust loop between intent, action, and impact.' Three bullets:
• 3 stakeholder types, 1 platform
• Every enquiry tracked end-to-end
• Impact visible to donor and beneficiary alike

Bottom-right small note in muted gray (Inter 11px): 'Source: India Philanthropy Report 2025; internal beneficiary survey 2026.'

No images.

slides.title: Platform Architecture at a Glance
slides.task_brief:
ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW. Light cream background.

Header:
- Eyebrow (uppercase gold 12px): '02 · ARCHITECTURE'
- Headline (Playfair 700, ~46px): 'One platform, two surfaces, twenty modules'
- One-line subhead (Playfair italic 20px, ink-soft, max-width 820px): 'A public website for outreach and an admin console for operations — built on the same data, governed by the same roles.'

Body — large two-column split (50/50). Each column is a tall .surface card with distinct color treatment:

LEFT COLUMN (top accent: thin gold bar)
- Big number (Playfair italic 90px, gold #d97706): '10'
- Below number, small uppercase label (gold, 11px, letter-spacing 0.2em): 'PUBLIC PAGES'
- Headline (Playfair 600, 26px, ink): 'Public Website'
- One-line description (Inter 15px, ink-soft, ~28 words): 'The donor, beneficiary, and partner front door — campaigns, donations, stories, transparency, and contact in one place.'
- A vertical list of the 10 pages (Inter 14px, two columns inside this card if needed, each with a small emerald dot icon):
  Home · About · Activities · Campaigns · Donate · Sponsorship · Gallery · News · Transparency · Contact

RIGHT COLUMN (top accent: thin emerald bar)
- Big number (Playfair italic 90px, emerald #0f766e): '20'
- Below number, small uppercase label (emerald, 11px, letter-spacing 0.2em): 'ADMIN MODULES'
- Headline (Playfair 600, 26px, ink): 'Admin Console'
- One-line description (Inter 15px, ink-soft, ~28 words): 'The operational brain — activities, beneficiaries, donations, finance, content, certificates, audit, and roles in one governed workspace.'
- A short grouped list (Inter 13px, 5 section labels in gold uppercase 11px, each followed by the modules):
  PROGRAMS — Activities · Beneficiaries · Events · Volunteers
  FUNDRAISING — Donations · Campaigns · Sponsorships · CSR · Grants
  FINANCE — Expenses
  CONTENT — News · Gallery · Documents · Certificates
  ADMIN — Enquiries · Notifications · Users · Audit · Settings

No images. Page-meta footer: 'TRUST MANAGEMENT PLATFORM · 03 / 08' bottom-left, 'BOARD BRIEFING · SEP 2026' bottom-right.

slides.title: Public Website — Client & Donor Connectivity
slides.task_brief: BENTO GRID layout showcasing the 10 public-facing pages. Light cream background. Header (compact, top 64px): - Eyebrow (gold 12px uppercase): '03 · PUBLIC WEBSITE' - Headline (Playfair 700, ~38px): 'Ten pages, one front door for every stakeholder' - Sub-line (Inter italic 15px, ink-soft, max-width 760px, ~22 words): 'Every page is engineered for a single stakeholder job — from making a 60-second donation to verifying a 80G receipt by QR code.' Body — bento grid (3 columns × 3 rows, mixed cell sizes, total ~10 cells). Each cell is a .surface card with: - A small Material Icon at top-left (24px, gold or emerald) - A tiny uppercase tag (gold 10px) like 'DONOR', 'BENEFICIARY', 'PARTNER', 'PUBLIC' - A Playfair-semibold page title (~18px) - A 12-15 word Inter description (13px, ink-soft) The ten cells (render verbatim, in this order, sized to fit the bento rhythm — make the Donate cell larger as the hero): 1. HOME — icon 'home' — tag 'PUBLIC' — 'Home' — 'Hero, impact stats, active campaigns, latest news, and testimonials in one scroll.' 2. ABOUT — icon 'info' — tag 'PUBLIC' — 'About the Trust' — 'History, trustees, advisory council, organisation structure, registration details.' 3. ACTIVITIES — icon 'volunteer_activism' — tag 'BENEFICIARY' — 'Activities & Projects' — 'Filterable project catalogue across 10 categories with impact metrics.' 4. CAMPAIGNS — icon 'target' (use 'flag' if unavailable) — tag 'DONOR' — 'Campaigns' — 'Active fundraising campaigns with live progress bars and donate CTAs.' 5. DONATE (HERO CELL, larger, ~2x size, accent gold border or different treatment) — icon 'favorite' — tag 'DONOR · MUST-HAVE' — 'Donate Now' — 'Three-step flow — donor info, UPI/Card/Net Banking, instant 80G PDF receipt in under 60 seconds.' 6. SPONSORSHIP — icon 'handshake' (use 'favorite_border' fallback) — tag 'DONOR' — 'Sponsorship' — 'Six recurring sponsorship tiers — child, education, food, medical, event, equipment.' 7. GALLERY — icon 'photo_library' — tag 'PUBLIC' — 'Gallery' — 'Photo and video albums with lightbox, filterable by activity and event.' 8. NEWS — icon 'newspaper' — tag 'PUBLIC' — 'News & Updates' — 'Featured article plus filterable news grid with categories and author bylines.' 9. TRANSPARENCY — icon 'verified' — tag 'DONOR · PUBLIC' — 'Transparency' — 'Live charts, annual reports, audited financials, and downloadable certificates.' 10. CONTACT — icon 'mail' — tag 'PARTNER · PUBLIC' — 'Contact' — 'Categorised enquiry form routing to the right team within 24 hours.' Page-meta footer: 'PUBLIC WEBSITE · 10 PAGES' bottom-left, '04 / 08' bottom-right. No external photos. Use Material Icons via and name.

slides.title: Admin Console — 20 Modules of Management Power
slides.task_brief:
ADMIN CONSOLE OVERVIEW. Light cream background.

Header:
- Eyebrow (gold uppercase 12px): '04 · ADMIN CONSOLE'
- Headline (Playfair 700, ~42px): 'Twenty governed modules behind one login'
- Sub-line (Playfair italic 18px, ink-soft, max-width 880px, ~25 words): 'Every record the Trust creates — a donation, a beneficiary, an expense, a certificate — is governed by role-based access and recorded in the audit log.'

Body — 5-column section grid. Each column is a tall .surface card with a colored top accent bar (alternate emerald and gold). Each column has:
  - Top accent bar (4px height, full width of card)
  - Tiny uppercase section number (gold, 11px): 'SECTION 01' through 'SECTION 05'
  - Section name (Playfair 600, 18px, ink)
  - A short single-line tagline (Inter italic 12px, ink-soft)
  - Vertical list of module names (Inter 13px, ink-soft, each prefixed with a small dot)

The five columns (render verbatim):

COLUMN 1 — 'SECTION 01' — 'Programs' — tagline 'Where the work happens' — modules: Activities · Beneficiaries · Events · Volunteers

COLUMN 2 — 'SECTION 02' — 'Fundraising' — tagline 'The must-have core' — modules: Donations · Campaigns · Sponsorships · CSR Partners · Grants

COLUMN 3 — 'SECTION 03' — 'Finance' — tagline 'Every rupee traceable' — modules: Expenses · Fund Utilisation · Reports

COLUMN 4 — 'SECTION 04' — 'Content' — tagline 'The story we tell' — modules: News · Gallery · Documents · Certificates

COLUMN 5 — 'SECTION 05' — 'Administration' — tagline 'Governance and access' — modules: Enquiries · Notifications · Users & Roles · Audit Log · Settings

Below the 5 columns, a slim full-width .surface-soft banner with this single line centered (Playfair italic 16px, ink-soft):
'★ Six predefined roles — Super Admin, Trust Admin, Accounts, Project Manager, Volunteer Coordinator, Content Manager — each with module-scoped permissions.'

Page-meta footer: 'ADMIN CONSOLE · 20 MODULES · 5 SECTIONS' bottom-left, '05 / 08' bottom-right.

No images.

slides.title: Fundraising Engine — The Must-Have Core
slides.task_brief:
FUNDRAISING DEEP DIVE. Dark emerald variant (.slide.slide-dark with .dot-pattern). White text on emerald.

Header:
- Eyebrow (gold uppercase 12px, color #fbbf24): '05 · FUNDRAISING ENGINE'
- Headline (Playfair 700, ~46px, color #fefcf7): 'The must-have core for fundraising growth'
- Sub-line (Playfair italic 20px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.78), max-width 880px, ~28 words): 'Five interlocking modules turn one-time donations into recurring sponsorships, corporate partnerships, and grants — with full transparency on every rupee received and utilised.'

Body — two-row composition:

ROW A — three big stat cards (.surface variant on dark — use rgba(255,255,255,0.06) background with 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15) border, rounded 12px, padding 24px):
  CARD 1: Big number (Playfair italic, 64px, color #fbbf24): '₹1.85 Cr' — small uppercase label (gold 10px): 'TOTAL FUNDS FY 25-26' — single-line note (Inter 12px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.7)): 'Across donations, CSR, grants, sponsorships.'
  CARD 2: Big number: '6' — label: 'ACTIVE CAMPAIGNS' — note: 'Average 65% funded, 4 closing within 90 days.'
  CARD 3: Big number: '3-step' — label: 'DONATION FLOW' — note: 'UPI / Card / Net Banking — instant 80G receipt.'

ROW B — five compact callout cards in a single row (use a 5-column grid), each card is a .surface on dark with a small Material Icon top (24px, color #fbbf24), Playfair-semibold title (16px, color #fefcf7), and a 12-word Inter description (12px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.75)):
  1. icon 'favorite' — 'Donations' — 'Three-step flow, instant 80G PDF, automatic donor database, payment failure alerts.'
  2. icon 'flag' — 'Campaigns' — 'Target tracker, live progress bar, beneficiary count, gallery, and donate CTA.'
  3. icon 'handshake' — 'Sponsorships' — 'Six recurring tiers, monthly auto-renew, sponsor certificates, renewal reminders.'
  4. icon 'business' — 'CSR Partners' — 'Corporate database, partnership status tracking, contribution reports.'
  5. icon 'account_balance' — 'Grants' — 'Sanctioned vs received vs utilised vs balance — full funding-to-project trail.'

Page-meta footer (gold tone): 'FUNDRAISING · MUST-HAVE CORE' bottom-left, '06 / 08' bottom-right.

No external images.

slides.title: Transparency, Compliance & Trust
slides.task_brief:
TRANSPARENCY & COMPLIANCE. Light cream background.

Header:
- Eyebrow (gold uppercase 12px): '06 · TRANSPARENCY & COMPLIANCE'
- Headline (Playfair 700, ~46px): 'Trust is earned, then audited'
- Sub-line (Playfair italic 20px, ink-soft, max-width 880px, ~26 words): 'Every record the Trust creates is traceable, every rupee accountable, and every certificate verifiable — by donors, regulators, and the public.'

Body — three vertical pillars (equal-width .surface cards, gap 28px). Each pillar has:
  - A Material Icon at top (32px, gold)
  - A small uppercase tag (gold 11px)
  - A Playfair-semibold pillar title (~22px, ink)
  - A short Inter paragraph (14px, ink-soft, ~38 words)
  - A 3-item bullet list (Inter 12px, ink-soft, emerald check-circle icons)

PILLAR 1 — icon 'visibility' — tag 'PUBLIC TRANSPARENCY' — title 'Public Reports & Live Charts' — paragraph: 'A dedicated public transparency page with monthly donation trends, donation source breakdown, and category distribution — alongside every registration document, audited financial, and annual report downloadable as PDF.' — bullets: 'Guidestar Platinum rated (3rd year)' · 'Annual reports, audit reports, 80G/12A certificates' · 'Live charts updated monthly'

PILLAR 2 — icon 'shield' — tag 'INTERNAL GOVERNANCE' — title 'Audit Log & Role-Based Access' — paragraph: 'Every admin action — who created, modified, exported, or deleted what, when, from which IP — is recorded in a searchable audit trail. Six predefined roles scope module access to the minimum each user needs.' — bullets: 'Searchable audit timeline with IP tracking' · 'Six roles: Super Admin → Content Manager' · 'Per-module permission scoping'

PILLAR 3 — icon 'verified' — tag 'DONOR ASSURANCE' — title 'Digital Certificates with QR Verify' — paragraph: 'Every sponsor, donor, volunteer, and event participant receives a unique numbered certificate with a QR code. Anyone — donor, auditor, regulator — can scan and verify authenticity on a public page within seconds.' — bullets: 'Auto-generated certificate numbers (TRUST/2026/000125)' · 'QR verification on public page' · 'PDF download + email delivery'

Below the three pillars, a slim full-width .surface-soft banner with this line centered (Playfair italic 16px, ink-soft):
'★ Registered under Bombay Public Trusts Act 1950 · 12A & 80G exempt · FCRA registered · Guidestar Platinum'

Page-meta footer: 'TRANSPARENCY · COMPLIANCE · TRUST' bottom-left, '07 / 08' bottom-right.

slides.title: Call to Action — Next Steps
slides.task_brief:
CLOSING / CTA. Dark emerald variant (.slide.slide-dark with .dot-pattern). Premium closing-page feel.

Layout — two-column split (60/40):

LEFT COLUMN (60% width, padded 80px):
- Eyebrow (gold uppercase 12px, color #fbbf24): '07 · NEXT STEPS'
- Main headline (Playfair 700, ~62px, color #fefcf7, line-height 1.05): 'Adopt the platform.\nConnect every stakeholder.'
- Sub-paragraph (Inter 17px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.78), max-width 540px, ~45 words): 'The platform is built, the design is ready, and the audit trail is in place. With database integration, payment gateway activation, and multi-language rollout, the Trust will have a fundraising and connectivity engine that scales for the next decade.'
- Three numbered next-step items (each row: gold circle with Playfair italic number, then a Playfair-semibold 18px title in white, then a 14px Inter line in rgba(254,252,247,0.7)):
  01 — 'Database Integration' — 'Replace mock data with Prisma models and live API routes.'
  02 — 'Payment Gateway Activation' — 'Wire Razorpay/PayU into the donate flow with live 80G receipts.'
  03 — 'Multi-language Rollout' — 'Activate Hindi and Bengali content across public pages.'

RIGHT COLUMN (40% width, padded 60px, with a vertical accent gold bar on the left edge):
- Tiny uppercase gold label: 'CONTACT'
- Trust name (Playfair 600, 24px, white): 'Ananya Seva Trust'
- One-line tagline (Playfair italic 16px, color rgba(254,252,247,0.7)): 'Serving Humanity, Building Hope'
- Small spacer
- Three contact lines, each with a small Material Icon (gold) + Inter 14px text in rgba(254,252,247,0.85):
